Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning transfers of clients between regional support networks.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to strengthening families by allowing transfersbetween regional support networks to be closer to relatives or otherstrong personal supports; and adding a new section to chapter 71.24RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 71.24 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) A regional support network may not refuse to allow a client totransfer from one regional support network to another when themotivation for the transfer request is to bring the client closer torelatives or other strong personal supports. (2) The department may establish rules and procedures governingtransfers of clients between regional support networks and assume theauthority to resolve disputes that arise. In the case of a transferrequest that does not arise pursuant to subsection (1) of this section,the originating regional support network may be required to makepayment for inpatient or residential services received by the client p. 1 SB 5153from the receiving regional support network for a maximum of six monthsfollowing the transfer.
